svg.title: How the MCP server decides whether a tools/call becomes a task
svg.desc: The MCP client sends tools/call. If the request's _meta does not declare the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension, the server must not return a task: it returns an ordinary CallToolResult, or error -32021 if the work cannot be done without a task. If the request declares the extension, the server chooses per request: an ordinary result for quick work or a task handle for long work. A Tasks-capable client must therefore handle both shapes. In this guide's server, a declaring client always gets a task handle.
